messages:
Maya (Product): Quick design review request — hitting a few UX edgecases in the Private/VPC setup wizard connectivity check. Want to align on microcopy + telemetry opt-in, and a11y for the live status area.
Sam (Design): TLDR please? screenshots welcome.
Maya (Product): Pasted the current modal copy: 
```
We will run a connectivity check to validate your network. Allow Redwood to collect anonymized diagnostics to help troubleshoot failures.
```
Two asks: 1) is this wording clear enough about what 'anonymized diagnostics' includes? 2) if the check fails, the failure panel is dense — need clearer remediation steps.
Nik (Eng): For the diagnostics: it only sends metadata (IP ranges, probe results, error codes, and timestamp). No app data or keys. We can make that explicit but short.
Priya (Accessibility): Also need a screen-reader-friendly description for the live status region. Right now it just updates visually. Use aria-live="polite" and add a hidden summary like: "Connectivity check in progress — results will be announced."
Sam (Design): Proposed microcopy tweak: 
```
Run connectivity check — we'll send anonymous network diagnostics (IP ranges, probe results, and error codes) to help debug. No app data or credentials are collected.
```
Maya (Product): That reads better. Jared, any legal/privacy flags?
Jared (PM): Works for me but add an opt-out link in the modal — a small "Turn off diagnostics" control that toggles a setting. We should also log consent in the org audit trail.
Nik (Eng): Opt-out flow is trivial — we already support the boolean in the POST: `/v1/private/setup/check?telemetry=false`. Example: `curl -X POST ".../check?telemetry=false"`
Sam (Design): On failure states: instead of a long paragraph, propose 3 compact lanes: "What failed", "Why it matters", "How to fix". Each lane has 1 line + a link to expanded guidance.
Priya (Accessibility): Also ensure error lanes are keyboard-focusable and set focus to the first failing item when the results return. Screen readers should announce "Connectivity check completed. 2 issues found."
Maya (Product): UX note: the primary CTA currently says "Retry check" — maybe "Try again" is less modal. Thoughts?
Sam (Design): "Try again" is fine. Also add micro-copy under CTA: "Tip: run as admin if you see permission errors."
Nik (Eng): One implementation caveat: some flakes happen because probes time out at 5s. If we shorten copy we should add tooltip explaining timeout behavior.
Jared (PM): I'll file a tiny PR for telemetry opt-out + audit logging. Maya, can you drive final copy and send to legal?
Maya (Product): Yep. I'll update the modal text and failure lane mock and post screenshots.
ci-bot: deploy-preview: UI proposal posted at https://staging.redwood.ai/proposals/1755555555 — build passed :white_check_mark:
Sam (Design): Awesome — thanks everyone. Quick follow-up: can we avoid repeating the word 'diagnostics' twice? Maybe second sentence: 'This helps our team diagnose failures faster.'
Maya (Product): Good catch, will tweak. End-to-end patch expected today.
